aids.nom: 城市最低生活保障 (Chengshi Dibao)
aids.description_en: Urban Minimum Living Guarantee (Dibao). Means-tested cash transfer ensuring households reach the local minimum living standard. National average approx. 800 CNY/month per person in urban areas (2025). Local thresholds vary significantly.
aids.organisme: 民政部 (Ministry of Civil Affairs) / 地方民政局

aids.nom: 农村最低生活保障 (Nongcun Dibao)
aids.description_en: Rural Minimum Living Guarantee. Ensures rural households reach minimum living standard. National average approx. 600 CNY/month per person in rural areas (2025). Funded jointly by central and local governments.
aids.organisme: 民政部 (Ministry of Civil Affairs) / 县乡民政所

aids.description_en: Five-Guarantee Support for rural elderly, disabled and minors without family support (no ability to work, no income, no legal supporter). Covers food, clothing, housing, medical care and funeral. Approx. 600-900 CNY/month.
aids.organisme: 民政部 / 乡镇人民政府

aids.nom: 城镇职工基本养老保险 (Jiben Yanglao Baoxian)
aids.description_en: Urban employees basic pension insurance. Average monthly pension approximately 3,300 CNY/month for urban retirees (2025). Funded by employer (16%) and employee (8%) contributions. Benefits depend on contributions and local wage index.
aids.organisme: 人力资源和社会保障部 (MoHRSS) / 地方社保局

aids.nom: 基本医疗保险 (Jiben Yiliao Baoxian)
aids.description_en: Basic Medical Insurance. Covers 50-80% of inpatient and outpatient medical expenses within designated hospitals. Urban employees scheme (UEBMI) and Urban-Rural Residents scheme (URRBMI). Employer contributes ~6%, employee ~2% of wage.
aids.organisme: 国家医疗保障局 (NHSA) / 地方医保局

aids.description_en: Unemployment Insurance. Benefit rate is 60% of local minimum wage for the first year. Duration: 12-24 months depending on contribution years. Available for involuntarily unemployed registered workers.
aids.organisme: 人力资源和社会保障部 (MoHRSS) / 地方社保局

aids.description_en: Maternity Insurance. Covers maternity medical expenses and maternity allowance during leave. Allowance based on employer's average wage. Maternity leave minimum 98 days. Employer contribution approx. 0.5% payroll.
aids.organisme: 人力资源和社会保障部 / 国家医疗保障局

aids.description_en: Housing Provident Fund. Mandatory savings scheme for urban employees to finance housing. Employer and employee each contribute 5-12% of salary. Funds used for mortgage loans, rent or home purchase at below-market interest rates.
aids.organisme: 住房和城乡建设部 (MoHURD) / 地方住房公积金管理中心

aids.nom: 北京市最低生活保障 (Beijing Dibao)
aids.description_en: Beijing Municipal Minimum Living Guarantee. Threshold set at 1,170 CNY/month per person (2025). Households with income below this receive the difference as a cash supplement.

aids.nom: 上海市最低生活保障 (Shanghai Dibao)
aids.description_en: Shanghai Municipal Minimum Living Guarantee. Threshold set at 1,420 CNY/month per person (2025). One of the highest Dibao thresholds in China.

aids.nom: 深圳市最低生活保障 (Shenzhen Dibao)
aids.description_en: Shenzhen Municipal Minimum Living Guarantee. Threshold set at 1,600 CNY/month per person (2025). Highest Dibao level in Guangdong province.

aids.nom: 上海市托育补贴 (Shanghai Youer Butiefei)
aids.description_en: Shanghai childcare subsidy. 3,000 CNY per child per year for families placing children in licensed nurseries (0-3 years). Additional subsidies for low-income families.
aids.organisme: 上海市卫生健康委员会 / 上海市财政局
